**[P1] Defer the record rejected after scheduler disablement**

When `_disabled` is true, `schedule()` drops the new record instead of returning it. The caller still holds its plugin `RLock`, so customer values in that record can run `__del__` as `_emit()` unwinds and re-enter another invocation's plugin, recreating the cross-invocation lock inversion this return channel is intended to prevent. Return the record so `_hook_frames.releases` clears it after all plugin locks are released, and cover the disabled path with a finalizer regression.
